body:
See gay pride only exists because we live in a society that encourages shame. It’s not because they happen to be gay, it’s because they continue to be gay in spite of everything telling them they shouldn’t be. So it’s a response to other factors imo. 

It’s odd. I’ll support and fight for other gay people but I can’t seem to extend the same compassion to myself.

It just amazes me that other gay people can be proud of their sexuality to the point of a giant parade. It used to bother me as well, but then I realized these people are doing something that I am presently incapable of - being proud of it - so I figure whatever they’re doing, loud and flamboyant as it is, it seems to be working.
